items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember a band, a cornet player called Buddy Bolden? ... [INTERVIEWEE] He died soon. Yes, he's been dead.

ctx.x: What's the name of some of those bands that played around them? Of course, we know about Joe Oliver and that bunch, but there was two or three fellas that had pretty good bands around them.
I used to hear you talk about this. I know all of them.

items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We brought Umfrey here too. The old man. >> [INTERVIEWEE] The old man.

ctx.x: We brought Umfrey here too. The old man.
The old man. We brought him here too.
